name: IFTTT MCP
description: Lets AI assistants run actions, query live data, and create Applets across the services connected to an IFTTT account, from Slack to smart-home devices, via a first-party remote MCP server.

skills.name: Service Search
skills.description: Searches IFTTT services, Applets, triggers, queries, and actions to find what can be connected for a task.

skills.name: Applet Management
skills.description: Creates, edits, and turns on Applets, including multi-action Applets and Applets with filters.

skills.name: On-Demand Actions
skills.description: Runs a service action immediately, such as adding a spreadsheet row or sending a notification, with no Applet needed.

skills.name: Live Queries
skills.description: Runs queries that pull live information from connected services, such as today's calendar events or the weather.

skills.name: Activity History
skills.description: Checks recent account activity to show which Applets ran, which were skipped, and which failed.
